about: Who we engage with on Instagram. status: active = checked and in the daily list, candidate = not yet checked (run engage.py watch-all), paused = skip, manual = not a business or creator account so the API cannot read it, check by hand. India-only content never goes through @ayurpet_global: a target meant for India lists only ayurpetofficial in accounts. This example file only holds public pet pages and brands. The real list (with partners and creators who wrote to us) stays on the laptop in engagement/targets.json because this repo is public.

quota_per_account_per_day.note: Comments on OTHER accounts' posts. Replies to our own followers are on top of this, answered within the hour. Every comment needs Kainaat's yes in chat first, is specific to the post, and is worded differently from every other one.
